::: {.hero}
# Welcome to MLS 202
**Medical Laboratory Sciences · Southern Africa Nazarene University**

Study immunohematology, blood group genetics, and clinically significant red-cell antigens through lecture material, worked examples, and clinical laboratory practice questions.
:::

## Start learning

::: {.unit-grid}
::: {.unit-card}
### Unit 1
**Foundations and Immunohematology**

Blood banking, immune principles, IgM and IgG, antigen–antibody reactions, compatibility and inheritance.

[Open Unit 1](units/01-foundations.qmd)
:::
::: {.unit-card}
### Unit 2
**ABO, H and Secretor Systems**

ABO inheritance, blood grouping, the H substance, Bombay phenotype and secretor genetics.

[Open Unit 2](units/02-blood-groups.qmd)
:::
::: {.unit-card}
### Unit 3
**Other Blood Group Systems**

Kell, Duffy, Kidd, MNS, Lewis and additional blood group systems with transfusion relevance.

[Open Unit 3](units/03-other-systems.qmd)
:::
:::

## How to use this site

1. Read the unit's **learning guide** before reviewing its lecture slides.
2. Use the embedded PDF viewer or download lecture slides for offline study.
3. Complete the **practice exercises** and clinical cases.
4. Refer to the [course guide](syllabus.qmd) and [resources](resources.qmd).

::: {.callout-important}
## Educational use
Content is intended for students, not as a standalone clinical transfusion protocol. Follow current local SOPs, compatibility-testing requirements and clinical governance in all patient-facing work.
:::
